title: Credential Context
description: Provider-neutral, runtime-neutral credential context contract of the Agent Credential Layer v0.3. A credential context identifies which credential reference is selected for an operation, by reference and never by value. It is a separate contract layer from the v0.2 Diagnosis Result and never carries secret material. Forbidden property names: token, password, secret, apiKey, credentialValue, authorizationHeader, rawCredential.

contractVersion.description: Public contract version of the credential-context layer.

provider.description: Provider identifier handled by an adapter. The schema itself depends on no specific provider (for example example-provider or any adapter-defined namespace).

operation.description: Operation the context is selected for (for example push, api, release, publish, auth-check).

executionContext.description: Safe execution-context facts reused from the v0.2 diagnosis layer. Unknown values are expressed as null; nothing here is forced.

runtime.description: Kind of execution context, if known; unknown is always permitted.

runtimeIdentifier.description: Optional identifier of the runtime/checkout, never a secret.

keyringAccessible.description: Whether the OS keyring is accessible from this context, if known.

envPropagated.description: Whether environment variables are propagated into this context, if known.

networkReachable.description: Whether the target network is reachable, if known.

toolAvailable.description: Whether the provider CLI/tool is available, if known.

requestedProfile.description: Profile requested by the caller or project binding, if any.

selectedProfile.description: Profile selected by the resolver, if any.

expectedAccount.description: Account the operation expects, if known.

expectedHost.description: Host the operation expects, if known.

availableReferences.description: Credential references available for selection, by reference only.

selectedReference.description: The chosen credential reference, or null when none could be selected (for example ambiguity).

ambiguity.description: True when resolution could not deterministically select and failed closed.

metadata.description: Safe, non-secret extension metadata. Must never carry secret material.

CredentialReference.description: A reference to one credential, never the credential value itself.

sourceType.description: Where the credential value lives. The reference itself is still only a logical reference.

reference.description: Safe logical reference, for example env/GH_TOKEN, connector/default, profile/personal, broker/github/work. Never a secret value.

account.description: Account that owns the credential, if known.

profile.description: Logical profile this reference belongs to, if any.

metadata.description: Safe, non-secret extension metadata. Must never carry secret material.

CredentialProfile.description: A stable logical profile. A profile selects references; it contains no secrets.

name.description: Stable logical profile name, for example personal or work.

references.description: Ordered reference ids this profile selects, by reference only.

expectedAccount.description: Account this profile expects, if known.

expectedHost.description: Host this profile expects, if known.

metadata.description: Safe, non-secret extension metadata. Must never carry secret material.
